original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH
  d1_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
  ),
  item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
  ),
  customer_filtered AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_current_addr_sk IN (
      SELECT ca_address_sk
      FROM customer_address
      WHERE ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
    )
  ),
  warehouse_store_filtered AS (
    SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, s.s_state
    FROM warehouse w
    JOIN store s ON w.w_state = s.s_state
  )
SELECT
  cd.cd_gender,
  cd.cd_marital_status,
  cd.cd_education_status,
  hd.hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
  store_sales ss
  JOIN item_filtered i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN d1_filtered d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
  JOIN warehouse_store_filtered ws ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN customer_filtered c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN web_sales w_sales ON w_sales.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND w_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND w_sales.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    AND w_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON w_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' day)
GROUP BY
  cd.cd_gender,
  cd.cd_marital_status,
  cd.cd_education_status,
  hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY
  cnt;

original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')       and i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ss_item_sk,
            ss_sold_date_sk,
            ss_customer_sk,
            ss_quantity
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    ) ss
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            ws_item_sk,
            ws_sold_date_sk,
            ws_bill_customer_sk,
            ws_warehouse_sk
        FROM web_sales
        WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51
          AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ws_warehouse_sk IS NOT NULL
    ) ws ON ss.ss_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
           AND ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 2001
    ) d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
        FROM date_dim
    ) d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
           AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk
        FROM item
        WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
          AND i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
    ) i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            inv_item_sk,
            inv_date_sk,
            inv_warehouse_sk,
            inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM inventory
    ) inv ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
            AND inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
            AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
            AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_state
        FROM warehouse
    ) w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
        FROM store
    ) s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            c_customer_sk,
            c_current_cdemo_sk,
            c_current_hdemo_sk,
            c_current_addr_sk
        FROM customer
    ) c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            cd_demo_sk,
            cd_gender,
            cd_marital_status,
            cd_education_status
        FROM customer_demographics
    ) cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            hd_demo_sk,
            hd_vehicle_count
        FROM household_demographics
    ) hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT ca_address_sk
        FROM customer_address
        WHERE ca_state IN ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')
    ) ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt

WITH d1_filtered AS (

  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
  item_filtered
  INNER JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = item_filtered.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN d1_filtered ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1_filtered.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN inventory ON inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity
  INNER JOIN warehouse_filtered ON inv_warehouse_sk = warehouse_filtered.w_warehouse_sk
  INNER JOIN web_sales ON ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 8 AND 28

  INNER JOIN ca_filtered ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_filtered.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk

  SELECT d_month_seq + 1 AS start_seq,
         d_month_seq + 3 AS end_seq

  WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 7

),
filtered_catalog_sales AS (
  SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE i_category = 'Men'
    AND i_class = 'accessories'
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
    AND d_moy = 7
    AND d_year = 1999
),
filtered_web_sales AS (
  SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE i_category = 'Men'
    AND i_class = 'accessories'
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
    AND d_moy = 7
    AND d_year = 1999
),
my_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  FROM customer
  WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1943 AND 1956
    AND c_customer_sk IN (
      SELECT customer_sk FROM filtered_catalog_sales
      UNION ALL
      SELECT customer_sk FROM filtered_web_sales
    )
),
my_revenue AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk,
         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM my_customers
  JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  JOIN store ON ca_county = s_county AND ca_state = s_state

),
segments AS (
  SELECT cast((revenue/50) AS int) AS segment
  FROM my_revenue
)

       count(*) AS num_customers,
       segment*50 AS segment_base
FROM segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment, num_customers

  JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number

  GROUP BY cs_item_sk

),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
    AND cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
),
filtered_ad2 AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_city, ca_zip
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH')
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name, i_current_price
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
),
filtered_date_dim AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2001
),
cross_sales AS (
  SELECT i.i_product_name AS product_name,
         i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
         s.s_store_name AS store_name,
         s.s_zip AS store_zip,
         ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
         ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
         ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
         ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
         ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
         ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
         ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
         ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
         d1.d_year AS syear,
         d2.d_year AS fsyear,
         d3.d_year AS s2year,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
         SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2,
         SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM store_sales

  JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d2 ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d3 ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100

  GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip,

           ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip,

  ORDER BY i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip
)

       cs1.b_street_number,
       cs1.b_street_name,
       cs1.b_city,
       cs1.b_zip,
       cs1.c_street_number,
       cs1.c_street_name,
       cs1.c_city,
       cs1.c_zip,
       cs1.syear,
       cs1.cnt,
       cs1.s1 AS s11,
       cs1.s2 AS s21,
       cs1.s3 AS s31,
       cs2.s1 AS s12,
       cs2.s2 AS s22,
       cs2.s3 AS s32,
       cs2.syear,
       cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1
JOIN cross_sales cs2 ON cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
                     AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name

WHERE cs1.syear = 1999
  AND cs2.syear = 2000
  AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt

ssr AS (

  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion fp ON ss.ss_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk

  GROUP BY s.s_store_id
),

  WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60

  FROM item

    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
),
sr_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty

  INNER JOIN valid_dates vd ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
